findings.title: Missing Critical HTTP Security Headers (6 detected)
findings.detail: Missing: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
findings.remediation: Configure HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options headers.
